V. 4.
He goeth before them—In all the Ways of GOD, teaching them in every Point, by Example as well as by Precept; and the ſheep follow him—They tread in his Steps: For they know his voice—Having the Witneſs in themſelves, that his Words are the w•ſ••m and the power of God. Reader, Art thou a Shepherd of Souls? Then anſwer to GOD. Is it thus with thee and thy Flock?
